dim_resolution.structure: flat_hash_set<int32_t> or small sorted vector + linear search

dim_resolution.outputs: cn_ok[id] bitset where country_code != us_code AND code != 0; also cn_name[id] for MIN projection

dim_resolution.notes: All 4 ct ids are valid; trivial join — no filter.

join_order.build: title (driver) with kt_ids and production_year > 2005 inline filter
join_order.notes: Driver loop over t.id v=1..N. Skip rows where production_year <= 2005 (also skip INT32_MIN sentinel) and where !kt_ids.contains(kind_id). Cheapest filters first.
For surviving v, scan mk rows; break early on first hit where kw_ids contains keyword_id. If no hit, skip v.
For each row: first check info_type_id == it1_id, then length prefilter (3..10 chars), then set probe. Break on first match.
For each row: info_type_id == it2_id, then lex compare info < '8.5' via memcmp. Track local_min_rating across all matching mi_idx rows for MIN projection.

For each mc row: (a) note present, (b) memmem find '(200' (LIKE %(200%)% — note '(200%)' means literal '(200' then any chars then ')'), (c) memmem NOT find '(USA)'. Then cn_ok[company_id]. Track local_min cn.name.
Per-thread MIN of (cn.name, mi_idx.info, t.title); combine across threads.

filters.predicate: info_type_id = it1_id AND info IN (10 literals)

data_structures.kw_ids: flat_hash_set<int32_t> or sorted small array (4 entries)
data_structures.kt_ids: small array (2 entries) with linear contains
data_structures.cn_name_view: raw offsets+dat pointers (no copy) for MIN projection
data_structures.aggregation: thread_local string_view tracking min, with final reduction

parallelism.notes: Parallelize the title driver loop. Each thread maintains thread-local mins; reduce at end.
